audit: independent sampled generalization stress and privileged memorization baselines

methods.fixed_table: All recipe cards, including held-out cards, compiled to fixed preparation/wait scripts using legacy catalog. Binds public order/card IDs, EDF between scripts, public burner index only; no legality filter or recovery.
methods.fixed_preparation_live_timing: RecipeReader sees correct cards and live ready timestamps but legacy ingredient rules. Isolates preparation-rule failures.
methods.public_rule_reader: RecipeReader consumes actual public cards/profiles/timestamps. All baselines use the real engine, same decision cap and replay verification.

fixed_table_positive_control.description: Paired kitchens with identical cards/arrivals/layout and generous 500-second deadlines. Only profiles differ: legacy vs generated. Validates fixed lookup implementation and isolates profiles from deadline feasibility. Both replayed.
